climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A subregion of Goulburn Valley in Central Victoria, around Lake Nagambie. Key grapes are Shiraz, Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc, Marsanne and Merlot, on well-draining iron oxide soil.
